Will EIP-4399 go in The Merge or next HF? it's planned for the merge Shouldn't it be in Review state at least? yes, the "security considerations" are being extended today/tomorrow and shifted to review Yes, both that one and 3675 should be moved. For past upgrades, we've moved EIPs to Review once they were formally accepted into the upgrade (then Last Call slated for testnets, and Final when on mainnet)
